final_netlist:
.subckt dut vin vout vref vss ibias
* ---- bias: IREF -> NMOS diode -> PMOS diode -> PMOS tail ----
MB0  ibias ibias vss  vss  nfet W=2 L=1
MB1  pb    ibias vss  vss  nfet W=1 L=1
MPB  pb    pb    vin  vin  pfet W=4 L=1
MPT  tail  pb    vin  vin  pfet W=10.2308 L=1
* ---- PMOS input pair (n-well tied to common source) ----
MI1  na    vref  tail tail pfet W=36.4659 L=0.268327
MI2  nb    fb    tail tail pfet W=36.4659 L=0.268327
* ---- NMOS diode loads ----
MNA  na    na    vss  vss  nfet W=1.07478 L=0.617543
MNB  nb    nb    vss  vss  nfet W=1.07478 L=0.617543
* ---- vref-side path: NMOS mirror -> PMOS mirror (sources into gate) ----
MNA2 pd    na    vss  vss  nfet W=1.07478 L=0.617543
MPD  pd    pd    vin  vin  pfet W=1.86768 L=0.381128
MPO  gate  pd    vin  vin  pfet W=14.2245 L=0.381128
* ---- fb-side path: NMOS mirror (sinks from gate) ----
MNO  gate  nb    vss  vss  nfet W=6.91906 L=0.617543
* ---- pass device ----
MP   vout  gate  vin  vin  pfet W=296.591 L=0.162362
* ---- feedback divider (Vout = 2*Vref) ----
R1   vout  fb    41404.1
R2   fb    vss   41404.1
* ---- Miller compensation with nulling resistor ----
RZ   gate  cz    33498.5
CC   cz    vout  2.06376e-12
* ---- fast transient path: vout drop -> less sourcing current ----
CF   vout  na    8.3761e-12
.ends
